messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGING (P1) - Increased 5xx rate for console-api in us-west-2 starting ~03:12 UTC. Affected: Console UI calls (/v1/console/*). No large spike in dataplane token requests observed. Pager -> @sre_amy oncall.

sre_amy: acknowledged, on it. quick question — is this showing as control-plane only? i'm opening traces and grabbing logs.

monitoring-bot: metric snapshot: console-api 5xx rate from 0.2% -> 8.6% over 03:12-03:26 UTC. latency stable. downstream (dataplane) error rate unchanged.

eng_karl: i can join, pinging from infra. i see a burst of 500s from console-api with message "config fetch timeout" in the logs. attaching small sample:
```
[03:14:58] console-api ERROR config: fetch failed: timeout after 5s (propagator=cp-propagator-3)
[03:15:01] console-api WARN fallback to cached config version=2026-03-15T02:58:00Z
[03:15:01] console-api ERROR panicked: nil pointer deref in renderRoute
```

ops_jules: confirming from customer side — saw a few customers report console UI errors when trying to open model settings. quoted message from support: "500 when opening model settings, page shows blank spinner". no embeddings/generation errors reported.

sre_amy: good. sounds like control-plane (config path) problem and console API crash on missing config. hypothesis H1: cp-propagator lag caused console to read stale/malformed config and then panic. H2: unrelated code regression in renderRoute. we'll test H1 first (cheaper).

infra-bot: suggested run: 
1) curl cp-propagator health: `curl -sS http://cp-propagator.us-west-2.svc.cluster.local/health`
2) kubectl -n prod rollout status deploy/cp-propagator
3) grab last 200 logs from cp-propagator: `kubectl logs -n prod deploy/cp-propagator --tail=200`

eng_karl: running checks now. cp-propagator health is flaky: some instances return 200, some hang. kubectl shows one pod in CrashLoopBackOff (cp-propagator-3). logs show intermittent etcd timeouts and throttling. snippet: 
```
E 03:09:41 propagator.go:214 fetchFromStore timeout: context deadline exceeded (etcd request)
E 03:09:44 propagator.go:221 retrying ...
```

sre_amy: ok — that matches. mitigation idea: restart cp-propagator pod first to drain and get a fresh leader. can we do a rolling restart with zero downtime? this is a prod stack with 3 replicas.

eng_karl: yes `kubectl -n prod rollout restart deploy/cp-propagator` — doing that now. i'll watch readiness.

pm_ravi: heads-up: if cp-propagator is the source, customers might see recovery in console quickly; i'll update support and CS with a templated message.

ops_jules: collecting timeline so far: 
- 03:09 UTC: cp-propagator begins getting etcd timeouts (per logs)
- 03:12 UTC: console-api 5xxs begin, first customer report at 03:13
- 03:14 UTC: pager triggered (monitoring threshold)
- 03:18 UTC: rollout restart initiated

sre_amy: after restart, looking at console-api logs — we see decreased "config fetch timeout" entries and a stream of successful config loads. still seeing a few panics but dropping.

eng_karl: quick note on rollback path: we have a feature flag push that landed ~02:58 UTC (flag: ui.newModelSettings=true). if this flag change included schema changes to config, and cp-propagator was mid-sync, console might read a partial state. rollback command if needed: `curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" https://controlplane/api/flags/ui.newModelSettings -d '{"value":false}'` (ops only).

sre_amy: do we have evidence for partial state vs bad config shape? need traces that show console requested config version X but received payload size 0 or missing keys. eng_karl, can you grep logs for "received empty config" or similar?

eng_karl: found entries where console logged "config payload size=0" correlated with panics. snippet: 
```
[03:13:58] console-api INFO config fetch version=2026-03-15T02:58:00Z payload_size=0
[03:13:58] console-api ERROR panic: missing routes in config
```

ops_jules: that seems strong for H1. did restart finish? any customer impact still?

eng_karl: rollout restart completed at 03:23 UTC. cp-propagator pods are all ready. console-api 5xx rate dropped from 8.6% -> 0.5% by 03:30 UTC. monitoring shows error rate back to baseline by 03:35 UTC.

sre_amy: mitigation done. next steps while in-incident:
- collect cp-propagator logs around 03:05-03:25 UTC and attach to incident ticket
- collect etcd metrics and see if there was a transient spike causing timeouts
- capture exact flag change windows from control plane (who pushed ui.newModelSettings?)
- prepare rollback/feature-gate checklist if we see repeat

pm_ravi: i'll capture the customer-support messages and post a short bulletin: recovery at 03:35 UTC, root cause suspected config propagation lag; will follow up with RCA.

infra-bot: commands/links for evidence collection: 
- logs extractor: `logs query "service=cp-propagator" start=2026-03-15T03:00:00Z end=2026-03-15T03:30:00Z --output json > /tmp/propagator-logs.json`
- tracer: jaeger link: https://jaeger.internal/trace?service=console-api&start=2026-03-15T03:00&end=2026-03-15T03:30
- etcd metrics dashboard: https://grafana.internal/d/etcd/etcd-metrics?from=2026-03-15T03:00&to=2026-03-15T03:30

sre_amy: adding hypothesis tracking to thread: 
- H1 (primary): cp-propagator experienced etcd timeouts leading to empty/partial config payloads -> console-api panics (evidence: empty payload_size logs, cp-propagator errors, fixed after restart).
- H2 (alt): a schema-incompatible flag push at 02:58 created transient invalid config while propagator was syncing (evidence to find: flag push event timeline).

eng_karl: i pulled the flag audit log: the change to ui.newModelSettings=true was applied at 02:58:34 UTC by svc-deploy-bot. it shows successful write to control plane. propagation to cp-propagator attempted at 02:59:02 UTC. timing aligns with H2 as an enabler.

ops_jules: ok so combined: race between flag push and propagator etcd instability -> partial config seen by console -> panic.

sre_amy: agreed. will open RCA draft and link artifacts. can someone own the followup action to add a safety check in console-api to avoid nil derefs on missing config (defensive programming)? assigning @eng_karl.

eng_karl: ack. i'll file a PR for defensive config validation and add a gating check before renderRoute. also will add a retry/backoff on config fetch with circuit-breaker to avoid immediate panic.

pm_ravi: scheduling post-incident review 48h window. i'll create the incident doc and tag stakeholders.

sre_amy: closing incident channel for now. final note: mitigation at 03:23 UTC, recovery confirmed by metrics at 03:35 UTC. RCA draft to be completed by EOD. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident P1 -> RESOLVED (recovery window: 03:23-03:35 UTC). Incident page: https://incidents.internal/1768456789
